# What does a mobile blood draw really earn once you count the drive, and is solo, an agency or a job the better way to run the route?

> Free mobile phlebotomy calculator: enter draws per week by type, fees, on-site and drive minutes, supplies, failed trips and fixed costs, and see profit per draw and per working hour, break-even draws per week, the fee for your target margin, what batching stops does, and solo versus agency contractor versus employed.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
